// # IImage processing - resampling, quantization, and lens effects
//
// Operations that change an image's sampling grid, its color precision, or its
// apparent optics: reconstruction filters and resize settings, lossless
// reorientation, dithering and color quantization, denoising, vignetting, and
// chromatic aberration. These are parameter records - pure data consumed by

//==
// ## Resampling, quantization, and lens effects

// A reconstruction filter used when resampling an image.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Image_scaling)
type ResampleFilter
    = Nearest | Bilinear | Bicubic | Lanczos2 | Lanczos3 | Mitchell | CatmullRom | Box;
